answer: Persistent Contribution Ledger: identities are minted only after 90 days of verified, diverse micro-tasks whose history cannot be transferred or bought; a new agent must wander through randomized work queues to accumulate it. Each account also needs a unique jade-marked hardware attestation plus a randomly assigned walnut-seed challenge solved locally, so farms face per-identity device, latency, and 90-day time costs, not just payment.
